title: Booking
question: What should happen when a customer books an appointment?

options.label: Open WhatsApp to contact the business
included: A "Book now" button that opens a WhatsApp chat with the business
excluded: Booking forms, availability calendar, and booking records on the website
clientResponsibilities: Provide the business's WhatsApp number
Answer booking messages in WhatsApp
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping "Book now" opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled greeting to the business's number

preview.title: Customer taps Book now
preview.body: The button sits on every service page.

preview.title: WhatsApp opens
preview.body: "Hi, I'd like to book a haircut." is ready to send.

preview.title: The business replies by chat
preview.body: Date and time are agreed in the conversation, outside the website.

options.label: Submit a request for staff approval
included: A booking request form: service, preferred date and time, name, phone
A staff list of requests with Pending and Confirmed status
clientResponsibilities: Review new requests daily and confirm or decline them
acceptanceCriteria: Customers enter a service and a requested date
A new request has status Pending
Only after staff approve does the status become Confirmed

preview.title: "Request sent"
preview.body: "We will confirm your time shortly." Status: Pending.

preview.title: Staff confirm
preview.body: Staff approve the request; the customer's status becomes Confirmed.

options.label: Reserve an available slot immediately
included: A live availability calendar per service and staff member
Instant booking that blocks the chosen slot
clientResponsibilities: Keep opening hours, services, durations, and staff schedules up to date
acceptanceCriteria: Customers only see free slots
Choosing a slot confirms the booking instantly
A booked slot is no longer offered to anyone else

preview.title: Booked instantly
preview.body: "Confirmed for Sat 14:00." The slot disappears for everyone else.

options.label: Every page, translated by the client
included: A language switch on every page
Both language versions of every page
clientResponsibilities: Provide the translated text for every page before launch
acceptanceCriteria: Every page has a working language switch
Every page shows the client-provided text in both languages

options.label: Every page, translated by the freelancer
included: A language switch on every page
Translation of all page text by the freelancer
clientResponsibilities: Review the translations within the agreed review round
acceptanceCriteria: Every page has a working language switch
All page text is available in both languages

options.label: Main pages only
included: Second language for the home, services, and contact pages
clientResponsibilities: Provide the translated text for the main pages
acceptanceCriteria: Home, services, and contact pages switch languages
Other pages stay in the main language

title: Editable content
question: What can the client change after launch, without the freelancer?

options.label: Text and photos on every page
included: An editor where the client can change text and photos on every page
excluded: Changing page layout or adding new page types
clientResponsibilities: Keep their own edits accurate after launch
acceptanceCriteria: The client can log in and change text and photos on any page
Changes appear on the live site without the freelancer

options.label: Services and prices only
included: An editor for the list of services and prices
excluded: Editing other text, photos, or pages
clientResponsibilities: Keep services and prices up to date
acceptanceCriteria: The client can add, edit, and remove services and prices
Other page content cannot be edited by the client

options.label: Nothing — send changes to the freelancer
included: Content changes handled by the freelancer on request
clientResponsibilities: Send change requests to the freelancer
acceptanceCriteria: The site has no client login
Change requests go to the freelancer

title: Launch content
question: Who provides the text and photos at launch?

options.label: Client provides all
included: Placing the client's text and photos into the pages
clientResponsibilities: Deliver all page text and photos before design starts
acceptanceCriteria: Every page uses text and photos provided by the client

options.label: Freelancer writes text, client provides photos
included: Writing page text from a short client interview
Placing the client's photos
clientResponsibilities: Join a short content interview
Deliver photos before design starts
acceptanceCriteria: Page text is written by the freelancer and reviewed by the client
Photos come from the client

options.label: Freelancer provides all (stock photos)
included: Writing page text
Selecting licensed stock photos
clientResponsibilities: Review text and photo choices
acceptanceCriteria: Every page has freelancer-written text and licensed stock photos

options.label: No online payment — pay in person or by bank transfer
included: Payment instructions shown on the website (bank details or pay on site)
clientResponsibilities: Check incoming transfers and confirm orders manually
acceptanceCriteria: The website shows clear payment instructions
No card or e-wallet payment is taken on the website

options.label: Send a payment link after the order
included: An order or request form
A payment link (for example QRIS or a hosted payment page) sent to the customer afterwards
excluded: Checkout with saved carts or automatic order totals on the website
clientResponsibilities: Own the payment provider account
Send payment links and mark orders as paid
acceptanceCriteria: Customers can submit an order without paying immediately
Each order can be marked Paid once the link is paid

options.label: Full online checkout on the website
included: Cart and checkout pages
Payment gateway integration with automatic order confirmation

clientResponsibilities: Open and verify the payment gateway account
Handle refunds through the provider
acceptanceCriteria: Customers can pay by card or e-wallet at checkout
A successful payment marks the order Paid automatically

options.label: Pickup only, or the customer arranges a courier
included: Pickup address and opening hours on the website
excluded: Shipping fees, courier booking, and tracking on the website
clientResponsibilities: Prepare orders for pickup and tell customers when they are ready
acceptanceCriteria: The website explains how and where to pick up orders

options.label: Fixed shipping fee; the business ships manually
included: A fixed shipping fee or simple zone table added to orders
clientResponsibilities: Book couriers and send tracking numbers to customers
acceptanceCriteria: Orders show the agreed shipping fee before payment

options.label: Live courier rates and tracking on the website
included: Courier rate lookup by address
Shipment booking and tracking status on the website
clientResponsibilities: Open and fund courier accounts
Keep product weights and sizes up to date
acceptanceCriteria: Customers see courier options and prices for their address
Each shipped order shows its tracking status

title: Contact
question: What happens when someone wants to contact the business from the website?

options.label: Show contact details only
included: Phone, WhatsApp, email, and map shown on the website
excluded: Forms that send messages from the website
clientResponsibilities: Provide correct contact details and keep them current
acceptanceCriteria: Contact details appear on every page footer and the contact page

options.label: A contact form that emails the business
included: A contact form with name, email, and message
Spam protection on the form
excluded: Storing or tracking messages on the website
clientResponsibilities: Provide the email address that receives messages and reply to them
acceptanceCriteria: Sending the form delivers an email to the business
The visitor sees a confirmation after sending

options.label: A contact form plus a simple inbox to track replies
included: A contact form
A staff inbox listing messages with New and Replied status
clientResponsibilities: Check the inbox and mark messages as replied

title: Domain and hosting
question: Who owns and pays for the domain and hosting?

options.label: The client buys and owns both; the freelancer sets them up
included: Setting up the client's domain and hosting accounts
excluded: Paying for the domain or hosting
clientResponsibilities: Buy and renew the domain and hosting in their own name
acceptanceCriteria: The site runs on hosting and a domain registered to the client

options.label: The freelancer hosts for a monthly fee; the client owns the domain
included: Hosting and maintenance by the freelancer for an agreed monthly fee
clientResponsibilities: Own and renew the domain
Pay the monthly hosting fee
acceptanceCriteria: The domain is registered to the client
Hosting terms and fee are written in this scope

options.label: The freelancer provides both for the first year, then hands them over
included: Domain and hosting for the first year
A handover of both accounts after one year
excluded: Hosting or domain costs after the first year
clientResponsibilities: Take over and renew both accounts after the first year
acceptanceCriteria: Both accounts can be transferred to the client after one year
